scene.description: Direct-frontal BEFORE/AFTER 50/50 horizontal split occupies the middle of the frame. A two-line ALL CAPS headline anchors the top: line 1 BLACK ('TIRED OF YOUR OLD WINDOWS?'), line 2 RED ('GET 40% OFF — LIMITED TIME') — IDENTICAL to V1 and V3. The left panel shows an AI-generated BEFORE — peeling old window frame, weathered sash, slightly degraded glass, in an existing exterior wall. The right panel shows the AFTER — a fresh AI-generated installation in the same opening, but the window STYLE differs from V1: e.g., a casement window with a single hinge-side opening rather than V1's divided-light sash, OR a sliding double-pane window rather than divided-light, OR a fixed-pane picture window with a clean white frame. Same dramatic transformation feel; different window style. Yellow rectangular BEFORE/AFTER badges sit at panel bottom corners. Google Business Review badge top-right. Compliance fine print at bottom edge. NO person, NO founder.
scene.subject: AI-generated alternate BEFORE/AFTER window pair. BEFORE = weathered old frame with peeling paint and aged sash, in a generic SoCal residential exterior wall. AFTER = fresh white-frame installation in the same opening, DIFFERENT STYLE from V1 (casement, sliding, OR fixed-pane picture window). Generic — NOT a recognizable CDW install.
